# Somebody speaking from inside the material can open it

## Statement
Where somebody in the material speaks from inside it, opening on that voice
gives the reader a way in before the argument starts.

## Applies when
feature first_person is yes

## Influences
- S-09 · `E-13.opening` — what the selected strategy may open on.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture record for the knowledge loader: eligible for S-09 and applicable
nowhere in the fixture's inputs, so that "read and did not apply" has something
to be read from.
